skills.name: repo-audit
skills.description: Audits a repository for the hygiene and trust gaps that block collaboration: missing or misdetected license and attribution, absent CI, dead internal links, stale metadata, credential-bearing files, and undocumented setup. Use when asked to review a repository, decide whether a project is safe to adopt or contribute to, prepare a repository for publication, or explain why a repository reads as abandoned. Use when a README promises more than the tree contains. Do not use for reviewing application code for bugs or vulnerabilities - use a code review or security audit skill for that.

skills.name: skill-authoring
skills.description: Writes and repairs SKILL.md files that agents actually discover and load: front matter whose name matches the directory, a description written for retrieval rather than for style, explicit tool boundaries, and validation against the repository checker before the change is proposed. Use when creating a new skill, turning existing documentation into a skill, fixing a skill that never loads or loads at the wrong time, or reviewing a contributed skill. Do not use for writing general documentation or READMEs.
